name: The DfE security.txt file needs to be accessible from active DfE websites to ensure vulnerabilities can be quickly reported via the HMG-mandated VdP. The file MUST be accessible without authentication and implemented on all domains resolvable from the public Internet
requirementTitle: The DfE security.txt file needs to be accessible from active DfE websites to ensure vulnerabilities can be quickly reported via the HMG-mandated VdP. The file MUST be accessible without authentication and implemented on all domains resolvable from the public Internet
requirementDescription: Every public-facing DfE website must publish a security.txt file so that security researchers can easily find out how to report vulnerabilities to the Department for Education through the government's Vulnerability Disclosure Programme (VdP)
why:
Without a clear reporting mechanism, a reported may:
- Not know who to contact.
- Send reports to a generic inbox that nobody monitors.
- Give up reporting the issue.
- Publicly disclose the vulnerability instead of reporting it responsibly.
